Further information is available at our corporate website www.enterprise-ireland.com Page | 10 3 Scope of the Framework Agreement 3.1 Type of Framework Agreement Enterprise Ireland proposes to engage in a competitive process for the establishment of a single-party framework agreement. A framework agreement constitutes a means of establishing overall terms and conditions in accordance with which, during the s pecified duration, individual contracts may or may not be awarded. It is emphasised that a framework agreement constitutes no guarantee to purchase a specific quantity of supplies or services from a particular economic operator. Indeed, Enterprise Ireland reserves the right to operate outside of the framework agreement at its discretion, particularly should it become apparent that doing so would offer greater value for money. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the framework agreement approach has been adopted in order to leverage efficiencies and maximise cost savings over the duration of the framework. 3.2 Numbers Admitted to the Framework Agreement The Framework Agreement will be established as a single party Framework Agreement with the Successful Tenderer selected following the submission of Final Tenders and the application of the Award Criteria. 1. Introduction

The African Union Development Agency – New Partnership for Africa Development (AUDA-NEPAD) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Resilient Irrigation for a Sustainable Economy Project”, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. “Consultancy Services to Develop and Deploy the Africa RISE Gateway”

 

  1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

ISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and process workflows, including a unified data interoperability Layer that meets vPIC standards and aligns with the Africa RISE Regional Geospatial Analytics Platform and national irrigation monitoring systems.  The architecture shall specify: (a) the endpoints and payload schemas through which national data collection tools, the Regional Geospatial Platform,  and other authorized external data sources submit and validate benchmarking data; (b) the data lineage and version control mechanisms ensuring that published benchmarks are traceable to their submission source; and (c) the traffic-light alert logic that translates performanc

sociated training materials for all user groups, comprising: (i) a Technical Track for AUDA-NEPAD IT personnel, national technical focal points and system administrators, covering system administration, data management, integration and cybersecurity; (ii) an Operational Track for programme managers, extension officers and policy stakeholders, focusing on effective use of the platform and its functional modules; and (iii) an End-User Track providing simplified guidance and orientation materials. Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Task 5: Envisaged functionality of the Africa RISE Gateway: The Africa RISE Gateway, as a go-to information and knowledge solution, is envisaged to serve.

ip_data_security.text: the cost of services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. This support service must ensure that users with legacy RealSAM Dialog licenses can use the My Talking Books skill in production. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. This scenario reflects the current state of affairs where the contractor is hosting all required non-GFE services (Auth Proxy, Streaming Servers, Dialog Engine, etc.). B. It is a globally integrated system serving over 9.6 million beneficiaries, including active-duty service members, retirees, and their families. The MHS is unique in that it functions as both a direct healthcare provider and a multi-billion-dollar health insurance payer through the TRICARE program. Its ultimate success

e medical capabilities, austere mission environments, field hospitals and Forward Operating Bases. DoW’s close relationship with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is paramount. The success of an integrated Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR) is a top national priority. Equally critical is the ability to support the continuum of care across operational and enterprise healthcare environments, ensuring that health information generated during military operations can be captured, exchanged, and made available to support continued care within the enterprise health record. Together, these operational, enterprise, and interagency requirements create a highly complex healthcare ecosystem that includes deployed medical environments, fixed medical treatment facilities, the Federal Health Care Center and other DoW/VA sharing sites. sla_onsite.text: ektse järjestatavuse. Terviklus ja muutmiskindlus Lahendus peab tagama logide tervikluse ning talletama muudatused ja ligipääsud auditlogina. Ligipääsuõigused Ligipääs logidele ja halduskonsoolile peab olema rollipõhine (Role-Based Access Control, edaspidi RBAC) ning võimaldama eristada vähemalt administraatori ja vaatleja õigusi. Eksport ja üleandmine Hankijal peab olema võimalus soovi korral eksportida logisid ja/või korrelatsioonireegleid ning teenuslepingu lõppemisel peab pakkuja andma logiandmete väljavõtte hankijale üle kokkulepitud formaadis. Eeldatav logimaht ja skaleeritavus Hankijal puudub käesoleval ajal keskne SIEM- või logihalduslahendus, mistõttu ei ole tegelikku logimahtu võimalik täpselt määrata. Pakkumuse koostamisel tuleb lähtuda tehnilises kirjelduses kirjeldatud logiallikatest ning hankija hinnangulisest logimahust 50–100 GB kuus. Esitatud logimahu hinnang on indikatiivne ning seda ei käsitata teenuse mahu ülempiirina. Pakkuja peab tagama kõigi tehnilises kirjelduses nimetatud logiallikate logide töötlemise vastavalt teenusele esitatud nõuetele. Lõppseadmete kaitselahenduse liidestamine Hankijal puudub hetkel tööjaamades tsentraalselt hallatav viirusetõrje (keskne Antivirus/Endpoint Protection Platform, edaspidi AV/EPP) ja lõppseadme laiendatud tuvastus- ja reag

elliselt, et tuvastatud turvanõrkuste teave on nähtav kesksel SOC-armatuurlaual. Igapäevane haldus Pakkuja teostab lahenduse igapäevast haldust ja teeb vajadusel täiendavaid seadistusi. Iganädalane hinnang Pakkuja koostab kord nädalas turvanõrkuste hinnangu hankija IT välis- ja siseperimeetri kohta. Prioritiseerimine Pakkuja järjestab tuvastatud turvanõrkused vastavalt nende olulisusele ja mõjutatud IT-vara ärikriitilisusele. Kõrvaldamise juhendamine Pakkuja juhendab hankijat turvanõrkuste kõrvaldamisel ning teostab vajadusel tehnilisi seadistusi ka iseseisvalt hankijaga eelnevalt kokku lepitud kirjaliku tellimuse alusel. Ohuteadmussöötmed Turbehoiatusi tuleb täiendada ohuteadmussöötme allikatest (Threat Intelligence Feed) saadava automaatse ohuinfo ja hinnangutega. Prioritiseerimine tunnuste alusel Turbehoiatused tuleb järjestada olulisuse järgi vastavalt ohuteadmussöötme allikatest saadud turvaohu tunnustele (Indicators of Compromise). Allikate mitmekesisus Turbehoiatuste täiendamiseks tuleb kasutada vähemalt kahte ohuteadmussöötme allikat. Esimese sisulise reageerimisena käsitatakse vähemalt juhtumi menetlusse võtmist, esmase analüüsi alustamist ning vajadusel hankija teavitamist vastavalt punktile 3.5.3. Reageerimisaeg ei tähenda üksnes teate kättesaamise kinnitamist ega turvaintsidendi täielikku lahendamise aega. Reageerimisajad lähtuvad tavapärasest SOC teenuse SLA mõjutasemete loogikast: Critical, High, Medium ja Low. "Severely disabled individual" means an individual with a disability (as defined in 42 U.S.C. 12102) who has a severe physical or mental impairment that seriously limits one or more functional capacities.
